checkpoint_model_function: checkpoint a model or part of the model to save memory during training
initialize_model_parallel_seeds: initialize model parallel cuda seeds for data and model parallelism RNG states
fork_cuda_rng_state: fork the cuda rng state to perform operations and restore the original state
get_cuda_rng_tracker: get the cuda rng tracker singleton to manage named RNG states
reset_cuda_rng_tracker: reset the cuda rng tracker to clear all tracked states and seeds
